Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring information to be filed by the prosecuting attorney for certain violations under driving while license is suspended or revoked provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring information to be filed by theprosecuting attorney for certain violations under driving while licenseis suspended or revoked provisions; and amending RCW 10.37.015.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 10.37.015 and 1987 c 202 s 167 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person shall be held to answer in any court for an allegedcrime or offense, unless upon an information filed by the prosecutingattorney, or upon an indictment by a grand jury, except in cases ofmisdemeanor or gross misdemeanor before a district or municipal judge,or before a court martial, except as provided in subsection (2) of thissection. (2) Violations of RCW 46.20.342(1)(c)(iv) shall be held to answerin any court only upon an information filed by the prosecutingattorney.
